name: Town Hall and Roland on the Marketplace of Bremen
description: In the heart of Bremen, northwest Germany, the old Town Hall faces the market square beside a 5.5-metre stone statue of the knight Roland, carved in 1404. The hall was built in Gothic style in the early 1400s, when Bremen joined the Hanseatic League, and given an ornate Weser Renaissance facade two centuries later. Remarkably, the whole ensemble, including a neighbouring early 20th-century town hall, survived Second World War bombing.
